notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Enable or disable notifications of start and end of meeting

storage.title: Data Storage Locations
storage.description: View and access where Meetily stores your data
storage.note: Database and models are stored together in your application data directory for unified management.

recording.title: Recording Settings
recording.description: Configure how your audio recordings are saved during meetings.

autoSave.title: Save Audio Recordings
autoSave.description: Automatically save audio files when recording stops
autoSave.disabled: Audio recording is disabled. Enable "Save Audio Recordings" to automatically save your meeting audio.

recording.fileNamePattern: Recordings are saved with timestamp: recording_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.{{extension}}

startNotification.title: Recording Start Notification
startNotification.description: Show reminder to inform participants when recording starts

devices.title: Default Audio Devices
devices.description: Set your preferred microphone and system audio devices for recording. These will be automatically selected when starting new recordings.
devices.locked: Device selection is locked while a recording is in progress. Connecting a new device mid-recording will not switch to it. Stop the current meeting to change devices.

autoSummary.title: Auto Summary
autoSummary.description: Auto Generating summary after meeting completion(Stopping)

summaryModel.title: Summary Model Configuration
summaryModel.description: Configure the AI model used for generating meeting summaries.

summaryLanguage.title: Summary Language
summaryLanguage.description: Pin one language as the default for new meetings. Unpinned languages remain as quick-switch options in the summary generator. Auto uses the dominant transcript language.
summaryLanguage.defaultHint: Default: {{language}} - click it again to unset. Max 5 quick-switch options.
summaryLanguage.noDefaultHint: Click any language to set it as your default. Max 5 quick-switch options.

beta.bannerText: These features are still being tested. You may encounter issues, and we appreciate your feedback.
beta.note: When disabled, beta features will be hidden. Your existing meetings remain unaffected.

importAndRetranscribe.name: Import Audio & Retranscribe
importAndRetranscribe.description: Import audio files to transcribe or retranscribe existing meetings with different language settings.

audioBackend.label: System Audio Backend
audioBackend.tryDifferent: Try different backends to find which works best for your system.
audioBackend.changeError: Failed to change backend. Please try again.
audioBackend.hintSystemOnly: Backend selection only affects system audio capture
audioBackend.hintMic: Microphone always uses the default method
audioBackend.hintNewSessions: Changes apply to new recording sessions

language.title: Transcription Language
language.parakeetText: Parakeet currently only supports automatic language detection. Manual language selection is not available. Use Whisper if you need to specify a particular language.
language.autoWarningTitle: ⚠️ Auto Detect may produce incorrect results
language.autoWarningText: For best accuracy, select your specific language (e.g., English, Spanish, etc.)
language.translateText: All audio will be automatically translated to English. Best for multilingual meetings where you need English output.

modal.confidenceDescription: Display colored dots showing transcription confidence quality
